Cells

The liiontr.cells package provides battery-cell definitions used throughout LiionTR.

Cell Base Class

Base battery cell definitions for LiionTR.

class liiontr.cells.cell.Cell[source]

Bases: ABC

Base class for battery cells.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Human-readable cell name.

  • geometry (Geometry) – Geometric representation of the cell.

  • material (Material) – Effective homogeneous material properties used for thermal calculations.

  • chemistry (Chemistry) – Electrochemical or thermal-runaway chemistry associated with the cell.

property volume: float

Return the cell volume in m³.

property surface_area: float

Return the external cell surface area in m².

property mass: float

Return the estimated cell mass in kg.

Notes

The mass is computed from the effective material density evaluated at 298.15 K:

\[\begin{split}m = \rho(298.15\\,\mathrm{K}) V\end{split}\]

where V is the cell volume.

property thermal_capacity: float

Return the lumped cell thermal capacity in J/K.

Notes

The thermal capacity is computed from the cell mass and the effective specific heat capacity evaluated at 298.15 K:

\[C_{th} = m c_p(298.15\,\mathrm{K})\]
__init__(name, geometry, material, chemistry)
Parameters:

  • name (str)

  • geometry (Geometry)

  • material (Material)

  • chemistry (Chemistry)

Return type:

None
